name: agent
description: The agent's mods: what used to be a rule in CLAUDE.md or a script on a timer now runs inside Claude Code

plugins.name: agent
plugins.description: Installs every agent mod at once: the usage-limit, memory, skill, audit, loop, secret and pipefail guards, the mod report, turn ratings, /wtf, the HUD and the spinner tip line.

plugins.name: usage-limit
plugins.description: Keeps the account usage limit from running out mid-task: one subagent at a time from 90%, a pause that keeps the last 2% for you, and an automatic resume when the window resets.

plugins.name: memory-guard
plugins.description: Keeps typecheck, build, test and Playwright runs under the session's cgroup memory limit, so the kernel does not kill them: runs them with one process, waits for memory or refuses, and reruns a command killed with exit 137.

plugins.name: skill-loader
plugins.description: Loads the right skill at the right moment, so CLAUDE.md needs no load-this-skill rules: typescript-best-practices for .ts, writing-for-agents for SKILL.md, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, domain-modeling for CONTEXT.md and ADRs, technical-writing for READMEs, commits and PRs, and a diagnosing-bugs reminder when you paste an error.

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: Records every MCP call that writes (Slack, Gmail, HubSpot, Notion, Calendar, Drive and others) in a daily file, so you can see what the agent sent on your behalf; refuses nothing, and /audit lists the latest.

plugins.name: loop-breaker
plugins.description: Notices when the agent goes in circles (repeated fix attempts on one file, the same error coming back, the same call repeated) and tells it to stop and change approach; refuses nothing.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Hides every secret value in tool output as <hidden:NAME> before the agent reads it, MCP and subagent output included, and writes the real value back when the agent puts the placeholder into a .env or secrets file.

plugins.name: pipefail
plugins.description: Adds set -o pipefail to a command that pipes a test, typecheck or lint run into tail, head or grep, so a failing run cannot exit 0 and read as a pass.

plugins.name: mod-report
plugins.description: /mods [days] reports what each mod did and what it cost per tool call, read from the mods' diaries, and flags the ones that get in the way.

plugins.name: rating
plugins.description: Records every agent turn as a dataset with your 1-5 ratings and automatic weak labels, for analysis and fine-tuning: rate with /rate or the band above the prompt, review with /ratings.

plugins.name: global-memory
plugins.description: Adds a machine-wide memory folder beside the per-project auto memory, so facts about the machine reach every session from any folder: rewrites the memory section for both folders and loads the global MEMORY.md.

plugins.name: wtf
plugins.description: /wtf sums up where this session stands and what the agent needs from you, in a few plain lines from Haiku, so you can return to a session without rereading it. The agent keeps working

plugins.name: hud
plugins.description: A heads-up display above the prompt: model, branch, context and plan limits, memory headroom, and the live tool, subagents and errors of the running turn. /hud opens the full view

plugins.name: spinner-status
plugins.description: Replaces the tip under the spinner with one short line from Haiku: where this session stands, or a tip about your mods and their commands that fits the moment
